definition: to finish an unpleasant but needed task
description: A young woman in a navy vest and work trousers throws her arms up and shouts with joy inside a sheep-shearing shed with a corrugated metal roof and wooden pens, as clumps of wool fly into the air. A freshly shorn white sheep trots away. She grabs a big armful of wool, drops to her knees and hugs it, laughing. Tired young men in vests sit slumped against the wall, an older man in a navy shirt sweeps with a broom, and a huge pile of fleeces lies at the back of the shed.

taps.phrase: to hug a bundle of wool
